claims.claim: Kinder Morgan Q1 2026 issuer reporting showed a $10.1 billion project backlog, approximately 92% natural-gas projects and nearly 60% tied to power-generation and local-distribution demand, with major projects supported by binding or long-term contracts.

risks.risk: Backlog realization depends on permits, construction execution and customer demand persisting through in-service dates.

unknowns.unknown: This source is Q1; Alpha should prefer Q2 filing/results for current numeric underwriting where available.

claims.claim: Q1 execution showed $2.539 billion adjusted EBITDA, $687 million free cash flow after capital expenditures and 3.6x net-debt-to-adjusted-EBITDA, while the company continued internally funding expansion projects; these are source-addressed operating and balance-sheet reference points for Alpha.

risks.risk: Weather contributed to Q1 outperformance and should not be extrapolated as structural growth without normalization.

unknowns.unknown: Current Q2 leverage and backlog changes are not established by this artifact.
